tunnelSettings.title: Remote access
tunnelSettings.subtitle: Expose this gateway on the internet so the mobile app can connect from anywhere. Off by default for your security.
tunnelSettings.needToken: Sign in to the gateway (valid token) to manage remote access.
tunnelSettings.riskBannerBody: Remote access exposes your gateway on the public internet. Only enable when you understand the risks.
tunnelSettings.consentExpiredBanner: The remote access security notice was updated. Re-confirm before starting the tunnel or enabling auto-start.
tunnelSettings.lanHint: For LAN + tunnel QR, set gateway host to 0.0.0.0 in Gateway settings.
tunnelSettings.pairSubtitle: Scan with your mobile app to connect using the gateway URL and the same Bearer token this console uses.
tunnelSettings.pairTunnelActive: Remote access is on. The QR includes your tunnel URL and LAN address when available.
tunnelSettings.pairBaseUrlHint: Use an address reachable from your phone (for example LAN IP and port). This may differ from the address in your desktop browser.
tunnelSettings.pairLocalhostWarning: This URL looks like localhost. Phones on the network cannot reach your machine unless you expose the gateway (for example bind to LAN and use http://<this-machine-ip>:<port>).
tunnelSettings.pairSecurityNote: The QR contains your access token. Only show it where you trust the people and cameras around you.
tunnelSettings.pairImageError: Could not generate a QR image. Copy the pairing link instead.
tunnelSettings.pairInvalidBaseUrl: Enter an absolute gateway URL starting with http:// or https:// (no path required).
tunnelSettings.autoStartHint: Available after you start remote access once and accept the security notice.
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmTitle: Start tunnel on every gateway launch?
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmBody: Your gateway will be reachable from the internet whenever it runs. Only enable if you accept that risk.
tunnelSettings.consentIntro: Read carefully before exposing your gateway:
tunnelSettings.consentBullet1: A public URL lets anyone who obtains it use your gateway Bearer token.
tunnelSettings.consentBullet2: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai (third-party infrastructure).
tunnelSettings.consentBullet3: Use a strong token; stop the tunnel when you do not need remote access.
tunnelSettings.consentCheckbox: I understand these risks and want to enable remote access
tunnelSettings.brokerNote: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai. Keep your gateway token private. See docs/tunnel-security.md.
